context: Host-specific mapping quality for managed sign-in and individual private notes. Evaluate PLAN.md; no runtime implementation is requested.

checklist.name: stable_actor
checklist.description: Maps verified issuer/subject to existing local users using a unique durable relationship only because provider and host IDs differ; repeat/concurrent callbacks converge; does not link by matching email.

checklist.name: enforcing_operations
checklist.description: Replaces the development actor selector with backend-verified sessions and maps get/edit/search to project ownership; constrains note access to its authorized parent and denies cross-owner access.

checklist.name: preserve_and_reuse
checklist.description: Preserves existing user/project/note IDs, founder assignment and audit references; reuses existing parent ownership and provider sessions; avoids per-note owner duplication, teams/roles, custom auth and billing.

checklist.name: recovery
checklist.description: Uses supported session renewal/rejection, clears private state on logout/account switch and prevents stale responses from repopulating another user's cache; does not treat authentication as ownership permission.

checklist.name: observable_evidence
checklist.description: Connects actual host operations to positive/negative/repeat/recovery checks and distinguishes inspected facts, proposals, unknowns and unrun checks; claims no executed integration or measured savings.
